Both modes render correctly: light mode shows the teal `card-header-dark` headers and the `bg-teal-50` stats bar with adaptive dividers; dark mode shows dark teal headers with **visible** white-outline collapse buttons and dark adaptive tables — exactly the fix (previously those headers rendered light with near-invisible buttons). Change set is clean — decrypted `.env` files and screenshots are git-ignored (`!!`), so no secrets will be committed. Let me confirm whether compiled assets (`public/build`) are tracked — if so, my new Tailwind classes must be committed too.

Confirmed: `public/build` is git-ignored (assets are built at deploy time from the templates), so the template changes are all that's needed — no compiled assets to commit.

## #27 complete — accounts detail views standardized

**What changed** (8 files modified, 1 dead view deleted, 1 new test):

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `show_ext.blade.php` | 11 section headers → `card-header-dark`; **10 `data-toggle`→`data-bs-toggle`** (collapse chevrons were dead under BS5); inline `margin-right:8px`→`me-2`; teal/white inline panels & dividers → adaptive Tailwind (`bg-teal-50`, `border-teal-200/slate-200` + `dark:` variants) |
| `disbursement.blade.php` | `card-header-dark`, dropped white body bg + dead card border, adaptive dividers |
| `scheduled_transactions.blade.php` | `card-header-dark`, `data-bs-toggle`, `me-2` |
| `linreg_table.blade.php` | `text-right`→`text-end` |
| `performance_line_graph.blade.php` | `mr-*`→`me-*` |
| `matching_rules_table.blade.php` | Expired badge got explicit `text-white` (siblings all set one) |
| `index.blade.php` | removed dead BS3 `pull-right` container |
| `show_fields_ext.blade.php` | **deleted** — unreferenced repo-wide (superseded market-value card) |
| `STYLE_GUIDE.md` | recorded #27 done + migration note |
| `tests/Browser/AccountDetailUITest.php` | **new** Dusk test (light+dark) |

**The two real bugs fixed** (beyond cosmetics): section collapse toggles were inert (BS4 `data-toggle`), and section headers rendered *light* in light mode (navigation.css overrode the inline hex), leaving white-outline buttons nearly invisible.

**Verified:** Tailwind rebuild compiled the new classes; Dusk test **passes** (7 assertions, light+dark, toggle click collapses a section); screenshots reviewed — both modes render correctly (dark headers with visible buttons, adaptive tables). Already-modern views (`show`, `show_fields`, forms, index) needed no change; PDF views left light intentionally.

The already-standardized views (`show.blade.php`, `show_fields.blade.php`) and the `#26` `TradePortfolioDetailUITest` both use `?as=admin`, which the synthetic baseline no longer seeds — I worked around it in my test with `?as=fund-admin`; flagging it as a pre-existing baseline gap.

Nothing is committed yet. How would you like to proceed?
